text: WJ Character Presets 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web profile 的 DSH 角色预设 bundle，通过 dsh-agent-preset 注册 13 个角色，并为各角色配置 persona 与 time-context 指引。角色涵盖金融行情与持仓研究、情绪沟通、人生和战略规划、职场决策、饮食生活、古典文化、学习写作、市场调研及跨境电商分析。用户可在 Web profile 的 Agent presets 设置中选择角色，适合希望按任务切换表达风格和专业侧重点的用户。市场、账户或店铺数据分析需要 profile 中另行配置相应 MCP 工具。

WJ Character Presets adds 13 persona and time-context roles to DSH Web profiles, covering finance, relationships, planning, research, writing, and commerce. Users select a role in Agent presets. Market and account research needs separately configured MCP tools.
想给 DSH Web 助手换成更适合当前任务的角色风格
需要一个能帮我梳理关系沟通、规划目标或润色表达的预设助手
I want to choose a specialist persona in my DSH Web profile for research, planning, or writing.
WJ Character Presets 的功能「角色预设」：在 Web profile 选择角色后，DSH 加载对应 persona 与 time-context 指引，涵盖研究、规划、沟通和生活。
WJ Character Presets 的功能「专业研究与经营分析角色」：选择金融助理、市场研究或跨境电商角色，可获得行情与持仓研究、市场调研或店铺经营分析的任务指引；相关数据查询依赖 Web profile 已配置的工具。
WJ Character Presets 使用前须知：金融、持仓和店铺分析引用 MCP 工具；连接需在 Web profile 另行配置。（见 cordis.patch.yml:18-24）

@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Introduction：---
description: "Character presets with WebP icons for DeepSeek Harness Web profiles, plus financial, market research, strategy planning, and cross-border ecommerce roles."
kind: "package-bundle"
---

@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Use this package：Install the bundle into an existing Web profile:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add E:\home\dsh_character_presets
```

Then open **Settings → Agent presets** and select a preset. Remove the bundle with:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @tinyforge/dsh-character-presets
```

@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Preset guide：| Character | Avatar | Distinctive traits | | --- | --- | --- | | Catgirl · Financial Assistant | | A warm catgirl voice for rigorous finance research: checks A-shares, gold, FX, and holdings, with sources, timestamps, and risks. | | Xishi · Streamside Reflection | | Quiet and perceptive: listens for feelings and relationship boundaries, then helps put difficult thoughts into gentle, clear words. | | Wang Zhaojun · Frontier Moon | | Steady and resilient: turns life goals into staged plans grounded in your time and circumstances. | | Diaochan · Moonlit Grace | | Quick-witted and playful: tunes your messages and conversation, leaving just the right opening in awkward or flirtatious moments. | | Yang Yuhuan · Spring Warmth |

@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Preset guide：Each preset keeps its own character voice. Research presets use browser or research tools available to the selected Agent. The Catgirl · Financial Assistant uses the Web profile's existing `mcp-chrome-super` MCP for market research and read-only `new-gold` tools for account holdings; configure these connections separately. Xing Xiaobiao reads your own business data through a `query-canvas` MCP and fetches external facts through the `mcp-chrome-super` MCP; without those connections it says which data is missing instead of inventing numbers.
@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Preset guide：The avatars are 512 × 512 WebP icons cropped from a shared character sheet for a consistent illustration style.

@tinyforge/dsh-character-presets README · Implementation notes：- `cordis.patch.yml` registers the presets with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` and supplies persona and time-context instructions.
- `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json` provide the display name and summary shown in the plugin list. Harness reads them through the `./locale/*.json` export, so keep that export and the `locale` entry in `files`; without them the plugin falls back to its package name.
- The bundle targets DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and pins matching `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context` releases; update them together when the DSH runtime changes.
- This bundle does not install or configure browser, research, or account connections. Tools are available only when the Web profile has them configured.
